title: AHP+ 1.3 relay and receiver receipt local gate
locator: npm test; npm run conformance; npm run validate; npm run pack:dry-run; ahp verify --strict
result: PASS: 25 core tests, 3 conformance tests, package validation, 62-file pack dry-run, and strict self-verification.
